bio: Surya Pratama is the founder and CEO of Orenji Music School, a music-education business. He is also co-founder of Arkas Ideas, commissioner of PT Sumber Agung Fastener, and a business consultant at Kojo Project, reflecting a career across education, creative work, and industry.

Cynthia Cecilia is the co-founder and managing director of Jobhun, an Indonesian career-development platform. She founded Jobhun in 2015 and led its transition into PT Jobhun Membangun Indonesia in 2020, with the platform providing training and career support.
Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, Government Relations for Millenial Job Center (MJC) Program.

Yemima Chandra is the founder of Veloute Beauty Lounge and a permanent make-up artist. She has worked in PMU since 2012, bringing more than a decade of beauty-industry experience to her entrepreneurial practice.
Raisa Akwilla leads marketing and business development at Transmarco Group. Her work spans branding, retail strategy, and regional marketing leadership for the group of companies.

Edwin Tranggono is the founder and creative director of Middleform Design Studio and a board member of the Indonesian Graphic Design Association (ADGI). A Surabaya-based graphic designer and comic artist, he also launched the independent Lineakomik label and created the titles Naraka, Sibiru, and Elang Hitam.

Bryan Valenza is a comic creator, author, and co-founder of Beyondtopia, an original storyworld rooted in Southeast Asian history and folklore. He is an exclusive color artist at Marvel Comics and previously worked as a colorist for DC Comics.

Stefani Gabriela, known online as Mama Nick, is a content creator and family storyteller. Her relatable family-focused videos have built a major social presence, including more than one million TikTok followers and a YouTube channel centered on creating the family she wishes to have.

Edwin Nafarin is a principal at Dpavilion Architects. His work includes Contertainer, a container-based public facility project comprising a polyclinic and library, and reflects his interest in accessible, people-oriented architecture.

Rendy Hendrawan founded Supratman Arsitektura in Surabaya in 2019. The studio has received architectural-media attention for adaptive projects such as Radjamie, which transformed a former pharmacy building into a characterful noodle restaurant.

Arief Budiono is Chair of the Startup Ecosystem of Surabaya and East Java and serves as Vice Chair for Creative Industry at KADIN. An ITS and Universitas Surabaya alumnus, he has also worked as a BAPPEKO Surabaya expert and a Ministry of Communication and Informatics mentor for digital ventures.

Yazerlin Nadila Balqis is the founder of Sayurmoms, a Surabaya-based online grocery business, and Chair of Paguyuban Cak & Ning Surabaya. She represents a new generation of local entrepreneurs building digital businesses around everyday consumer needs.

Andrew Hartono is CEO of NAIL2000, a role he has held since 2010, and CEO of GTS Power Genset since 2017. He also served as 2025 Local President of JCI East Java, pairing industrial-business leadership with youth civic leadership.

Ryan Wirasasmita is CEO of PT Buana Triarta, an Indonesian hardwood manufacturer and construction-solutions company, a position he has held since 2010. He is also the founder of Timberlab Asia and terradeck, extending his work into timber innovation and sustainable material solutions.

Aristia Chen is co-founder and chief marketing officer of Mazuta Group, a fast-growing Indonesian distributor of global consumer and lifestyle brands. She leads brand growth for a portfolio that includes Ecovacs, Tineco, Laifen, and Usmile, and has been recognized by Prestige Indonesia's 40 Under 40.

Evelyn Jiang is an Indonesian Mandopop producer, singer, and songwriter. She is known for producing her own songs and has developed a prominent audience across streaming and social platforms as an Indonesian Chinese-language music artist.

Rosiana Ayu is Creative Marketing Director at REI Skin and a multidisciplinary creative strategist. With more than 12 years of experience in branding, design, and marketing direction, she helps shape the Surabaya skincare company's creative identity.
Jocab Santosa is Creative Director at 8IDEA Studio. He is a visual storyteller and creative thinker whose work focuses on translating ideas into impactful visual narratives.

Mathina is the founder of Fablyme, a skincare brand centered on self-love and holistic wellness. As a neurodivergent founder, she has positioned the brand as an inclusive space for self-acceptance, well-being, and compassion.

Joefanca is co-founder of Fablyme, an inclusive skincare and wellness brand. A neurodivergent founder, she advocates through the brand for self-growth, compassion, acceptance, and respect for individual journeys.

Chikology is a content creator and mental-health counselor who uses digital platforms to engage a large Indonesian audience. Her TikTok account has attracted hundreds of thousands of followers, giving her a notable presence in creator-led conversations around well-being.

Mizan Tamimy Sulthon is CEO of Parahita Diagnostic Center, a healthcare diagnostics provider. He is also known as a healthcare marketing leader and serves as CEO of Kamila Printing & Packaging, bringing cross-sector operating experience to his work.

Charles Wonsono is Healthcare Business Director at Siloam Hospitals Group. He leads the group's non-hospital healthcare portfolio and has also held strategy and business-effectiveness leadership responsibilities within the organization.

Arumi Bachsin is an Indonesian actress, model, and public figure. She became known through television dramas and films, with early screen credits including Azizah and Bestfriend? (2008), and remains a visible media personality.

Emil Elestianto Dardak is Vice Governor of East Java and previously served as Regent of Trenggalek from 2016 to 2019. A public-policy leader with business and academic credentials, he received the Philip Kotler Entrepreneur Award in 2017 and is a prominent voice on regional development and creative-economy issues.
